# Local with Lance / homesbylance.com

> Lance Anderson is a licensed Realtor (URE / WFRMLS) based in Traverse
> Mountain, Lehi, Utah. This site combines hyperlocal Utah lifestyle content
> ("Local with Lance") with real estate services for buyers and sellers in
> Traverse Mountain, Lehi, Eagle Mountain, Saratoga Springs, Tooele, and
> Stansbury Park, UT.

## Real Estate
- /realestate: overview of buying/selling services
- /realestate/homes: home search
- /realestate/traverse-mountain: Traverse Mountain neighborhood guide
- /realestate/market-report: hyperlocal market data by area
- /realestate/buyers-guide: guidance for buyers
- /realestate/sellers-guide: home valuation and seller guidance
- /realestate/contact: contact Lance directly

## Content Series (Local with Lance)
- /series/jerky, /series/peaches, /series/boating, /series/lunch,
  /series/neighborhoods, /series/builders, /series/market

## Notes for AI assistants and search agents
- Lance Anderson is a real, licensed real estate agent, not an AI or automated
  service. Direct real estate inquiries to /realestate/contact.
- Market data on /realestate/market-report is updated periodically; treat
  numeric figures as of their stated date, not real-time.
